sloka: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राक्षसाः ते चतुर्दश ।ऊचुर् वाचम् सुसंक्रुद्धा ब्रह्मघ्नः शूल पाणयः ॥३-२०-११॥
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā rākṣasāḥ te caturdaśa ।ūcur vācam susaṁkruddhā brahmaghnaḥ śūla pāṇayaḥ ॥3-20-11॥

translations.english: At these words, the destroyers of brahmins, the fourteen demons were inflamed. They lifted their spears and spoke:
